analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold at 40.3 but remains neutral. MACD histogram shows slight improvement but lacks conviction. ADX at 28.7 indicates a trend, but -DI is stronger than +DI. 5-day price action shows no clear direction. Current price $56.23 is below short-term SMAs (5, 20, 50). Weekly RSI is neutral at 53.1, and weekly MACD histogram shows potential for bearish crossover. 4-hour RSI is also attempting to exit oversold. Overall, difficult to determine a clear buy or sell bias.
